name: Hyster-Yale, Inc.
summary: Hyster-Yale, Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides lift trucks, attachments, parts, fleet management services, and technology and energy solutions worldwide. The company manufactures components, such as frames, masts, and transmissions; and assembles lift trucks. It markets its products primarily under the Hyster, Yale, and Nuvera brands to independent Hyster and Yale retail dealerships. The company also offers lift truck attachments, forks, masts, and lift tables under the Bolzoni, Auramo, and Meyer brands, as well as parts under the UNISOURCE brand.
